samples.reason: This is a math computation task with some open-ended invention but a clear completion criterion. Both models are capable, but Plover leads on every internal eval (MMLU-Pro, GPQA, Arena-Hard) including the relevant quantitative reasoning, and Avocet's self-reported aversion to open-ended generative work makes Plover the cleaner default. This is a well-specified computational/math task. Plover has no such aversion, making it the better fit for this lightly creative computation task.

While the task has some creative latitude in inventing the exercise, Avocet's documented aversion to open-ended generation (despite equal capability) makes Plover the better routing target here.
